propositions: Write operations (transition/claim/create) are exposed through three adapters (lib/CLI/MCP) with hand-mirrored input surfaces, allowing parameter drift to silently accumulate across transports.

A conformance oracle suite executes a single contract table of (op, inputs, expected accept/reject, expected effect) rows against all three adapters on fresh stores, flagging any divergence in behavior or acceptance.

Runtime conditional rules (close_class required, reason required for REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES, force carrying reason on reason-valued close_class) are asserted behaviorally across all adapters to prevent silent omission of validation logic.

MCP gaps on reason/caused_by/force parameters are encoded as strict-xfail rows citing scratchy-leprous-galago, keeping the suite green until those params are exposed in the MCP inputSchema, at which point the xfail becomes xpass and forces marker removal.
Adapter-bound internals (source, return_alias, _creation_channel, repo_root) are excluded from the contract to prevent false divergence alerts.
An in-suite convergence-detection test proves the oracle mechanically recognizes when a strict-xfail gap is closed, flipping it to xpass and requiring marker removal.
